note: Public list prices on the date, Linux x64, for the size each provider is tested at. Free minutes, plans and discounts are excluded from per-run cost.

blacksmith-2vcpu.note: per-minute billing; per-job rounding not stated publicly, whole minutes observed

aws-m8a.large-on-demand.method: billed seconds from instance launch to termination (60 s minimum) plus the root volume, per job; computed by selfhosted/aws cost collector

gcp-n4d-standard-2-pool.method: always-on pool: job run time / U at the VM's per-second price; U = 0.5 (sensitivity 0.25 and 0.75 in METHOD.md); disk added per VM-second
gcp-n4d-standard-2-pool.disk_note: n4d accepts only Hyperdisk: hyperdisk-balanced 75 GiB at the included baseline performance, $0.08/GiB-month

gcp-n4d-highmem-2-pool.method: next memory size (2 vCPU / 16 GiB) for workloads that need more than 8 GiB without swap; 2 x $0.02911 core-hour + 16 x $0.00331 GiB-hour

aws-r8a.large-on-demand.method: next memory size (2 vCPU / 16 GiB); billed like aws-m8a.large-on-demand

runson-aws.method: EC2 instance seconds x the price paid for that instance (spot price history for spot), plus the root volume, plus the licence amortised over the reference volume; computed by a collector from the instances RunsOn tags
